content.description: API endpoint that polls an external AIS provider (VesselFinder, Datalastic, or MarineTraffic) for vessel positions by IMO numbers from the tenant's fleet, upserts results into iot_vessel_positions table. Tenant-configurable API key stored in tenant metadata. Designed to be called by a cron job or manual trigger.
capabilities: POST /api/v1/tracking/ais-poll — triggers AIS data fetch for tenant's fleet
Reads vessel IMO numbers from chartering_vessel_management or capacity_voyage_management tables
Calls external AIS API with tenant's configured API key
Supports VesselFinder API as primary provider (free tier: 200 calls/month)
Falls back gracefully if API key not configured — returns instruction message
Rate limiting: max 1 poll per 5 minutes per tenant
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/tracking/ais-poll returns 200 with count of vessels updated
Vessels positions appear on map after poll + refresh
If no AIS API key configured, returns 422 with helpful setup message
Rate limited: returns 429 if called within 5 minutes of last poll
Each poll creates new iot_vessel_positions rows (not updates — keeps history)
Works with VesselFinder API v2 format
edge_cases: Tenant has no vessels in system — returns 200 with 0 vessels polled
AIS API returns partial data (some vessels not found) — upsert found ones, skip missing
AIS API timeout (>10s) — abort and return partial results
AIS API returns 429 (rate limited) — return error with retry-after info
Vessel IMO not in AIS database (e.g., small vessel) — skip silently
Duplicate poll within 5 minutes — return 429 with remaining cooldown time
error_handling: AIS API network error — return 502 with 'AIS provider unavailable' message
AIS API auth error (invalid key) — return 502 with 'Invalid AIS API key' message
DB insert error — log server-side, return 500 generic message

error.message: AIS API key not configured. Set it in tenant settings.
